description: Source code implementing a TinySRP client for SRP authentication, including functions for client initialization, key generation, password processing, session key derivation, verification, and cleanup.

methods.name: t_clientopen
methods.description: Initializes a new SRP client session with user credentials and parameters, performing validation and hashing.

methods.name: t_clientgenexp
methods.description: Generates a public ephemeral value (A) for the SRP protocol.

methods.name: t_clientpasswd
methods.description: Computes verifier values (p and v) based on the password.

methods.name: t_clientgetkey
methods.description: Derives the session key from server-provided value and client ephemeral.

methods.name: t_clientverify
methods.description: Verifies server response against expected hash.

methods.name: t_clientclose
methods.description: Cleans up and frees the client session data.
